changelog:
- Initial release of the seo-schema skill.
- Detects, validates, and generates Schema.org structured data, preferring JSON-LD format.
- Flags deprecated and retired schema types based on the latest Google and Schema.org changes up to June 2026.
- Provides ready-to-use JSON-LD templates for major schema types (Organization, LocalBusiness, Article, etc.).
- Offers error handling and practical CLI examples for schema detection, validation, and generation.
- Outputs detailed validation reports, recommendations, and paste-ready schema code for implementation.
summary: Detect, validate, and generate Schema.org structured data. JSON-LD format preferred. Use when user says "schema", "structured data", "rich results", "JSON-LD", or "markup".
